title: LFM2-8B-A1B layer 17, 8 experts for science_papers (donor skill map)

evidence.claim: router pick rate of 8 experts at layer 17 of LFM2-8B-A1B on 'science_papers' text against general text; measured inside the donor only, not a gain on a host
evidence.metric: mean pick rate over the listed experts, as recorded by maps.py
evidence.split: search half of the skill text (the half that chose the part)

evidence.claim: log of the ratio of skill pick rate to general pick rate for 8 experts at layer 17 of LFM2-8B-A1B
evidence.metric: mean log ratio over the listed experts, nats
evidence.split: search half of the skill text (the half that chose the part)

evidence.claim: the same log ratio on the other half of the text; every listed expert is positive on both halves
evidence.metric: mean held-out log ratio over the listed experts, nats
evidence.split: held-out half of the skill text (checks the choice)

signature.method: router pick rate on skill text over general_text, per expert; an expert is listed when its log ratio is positive on both halves; the top experts by search log ratio are kept
signature.data: ccdv/arxiv-summarization document train: arXiv paper text continuation
signature.scope: measured inside the donor only, not a gain on a host

selection_data: ccdv/arxiv-summarization document train: arXiv paper text continuation
